overview.projectName: PulseTrack — Biometric Heart Rate & SpO2 Health Wearable Wristband
overview.summary: PulseTrack is an ultra-compact ergonomic wrist wearable designed for real-time photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse oximetry, skin temperature tracking, and haptic biometric alert feedback.
overview.problemStatement: Patients and fitness users needing continuous cardiovascular vitals monitoring are hindered by bulky medical equipment and inconvenient wired fingertip sensors.
goals: Continuously measure capillary pulse rate and blood oxygen saturation (SpO2)
Vibrate subtly on the wrist when arrhythmia or hypoxic thresholds are detected
Provide a crisp circular color readout with 36-hour single-charge battery autonomy
scope: MAX30102 integrated optical pulse oximeter with skin contact lens
NTC precision skin thermistor for surface temperature tracking
ESP32-C3 ultra-low-power RISC-V microcontroller with BLE 5.0
3.7V 300mAh LiPo battery with magnetic pogo-pin charging

features.name: Optical Photoplethysmography Pulse & SpO2 Sensing
features.description: Directs red and infrared optical wavelengths through skin capillaries to calculate heart rate and blood oxygen saturation.

features.name: Continuous Epidermal Temperature Tracking
features.description: Measures localized skin temperature using a calibrated precision thermistor located on the bottom case plate.

features.name: Silent Haptic Arrhythmia Vibration Feedback
features.description: Triggers discrete pattern pulses from an internal ERM coin motor when heart rate exceeds customized threshold limits.

features.name: Circular AMOLED Vitals Watchface
features.description: Renders live pulse BPM, SpO2 percentage, battery meter, and step counter on a high-contrast circular display.

roles.name: Wearable User
roles.description: Wears wristband during daily activities and inspects real-time vitals and vibration alerts.

requirements.description: System shall sample PPG sensor at 100Hz with digital noise reduction to filter motion artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Heart rate accuracy within +/- 3 BPM compared to ECG baseline

requirements.description: Device must operate for a minimum of 36 continuous hours on a single 300mAh battery charge.
acceptanceCriteria: Deep-sleep current draw under 25uA between display wake-ups

requirements.description: Enclosure bottom plate and optical window must be biocompatible and hypoallergenic.
acceptanceCriteria: ISO 10993 cytotoxicity and skin irritation compliance

teamRoles.responsibility: Schematic design, breadboard circuit assembly, component sourcing, and enclosure modeling
ESP32 C++/Arduino firmware, ADC filtering algorithms, and I2C display drivers

estimatedCost.basis: Prototyping components, breadboard, custom 3D printed enclosure, and 5V power adapter.
estimatedCost.disclaimer: Approximate estimate based on the supplied requirements.

resources.name: Electronics Prototyping Bench
resources.purpose: Soldering, breadboarding, and digital multimeter testing

hardware.workingPrinciple: MAX30102 optical sensor directs alternating 660nm red and 880nm infrared light into capillary bed tissue. Photodiode voltage fluctuations are sampled via I2C by the ESP32-C3 RISC-V core. If BPM or oxygen saturation violates safety boundaries, a miniature coin vibration motor pulses while the circular AMOLED display turns amber/red.

components.name: ESP32-C3 Ultra-Low-Power BLE Micro Module
components.purpose: Single-core 160MHz RISC-V processor with integrated Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0 and hardware cryptographic engine
components.specification: ESP32-C3-WROOM-02, 160MHz 32-bit RISC-V, 400KB SRAM, 4MB Flash, compact 18x14mm form-factor

components.name: MAX30102 Optical PPG Heart Rate & SpO2 Sensor
components.purpose: Skin-contact photoplethysmography sensor measuring blood volumetric absorption peaks
components.specification: Dual LED (660nm / 880nm), integrated photodetector, 18-bit ADC, I2C interface, 1.8V logic

components.name: NTC Precision Medical Skin Thermistor
components.purpose: Localized epidermal surface temperature sensor embedded in bottom casing
components.specification: 10k ohm @ 25C, 1% tolerance, B-value 3950K, stainless disc contact cap

components.name: ERM Coin-Type Haptic Micro-Vibration Motor
components.purpose: Silent tactile wrist notification for threshold alerts and button tap feedback
components.specification: 10mm diameter x 3mm height, 3V DC, 75mA, 12,000 RPM eccentric rotating mass

components.name: 0.96-Inch Circular AMOLED Color Display
components.purpose: Ultra-crisp circular vitals dashboard showing live pulse BPM and oxygen saturation
components.specification: 240x240 pixel resolution, GC9A01 SPI driver, 65k full color, 300 nits brightness

components.name: 3.7V 300mAh Miniature Rechargeable LiPo Battery
components.purpose: Lightweight internal battery providing 36 hours of continuous biometric tracking
components.specification: 3.7V nominal, 300mAh, integrated PCM over-discharge/short-circuit protection, 502030 pouch

components.name: Magnetic 2-Pin Pogo USB Charging Port & TP4056 IC
components.purpose: Waterproof magnetic charging interface with linear constant-current LiPo management

roadmap.title: Phase 1: Optical PPG & Temperature Sensor Validation
roadmap.description: Validate MAX30102 I2C register configuration and NTC thermistor ADC readout.
tasks: Interface MAX30102 over I2C with ESP32-C3
Implement SpO2 and pulse peak detection algorithm
Calibrate Steinhart-Hart equation for skin thermistor
completionCriteria: Accurate pulse BPM and temperature displayed on serial terminal

roadmap.title: Phase 2: AMOLED Display & Haptic Alert Feedback
roadmap.description: Implement circular watchface graphics and silent ERM motor vibration patterns.
tasks: Port GC9A01 circular display driver for ESP32-C3
Design real-time heart rate gauge and battery indicator
Create PWM vibration patterns for arrhythmia threshold alerts
completionCriteria: Vitals render cleanly on round AMOLED and buzzer/motor vibrates on alert

roadmap.title: Phase 3: Ergonomic Wrist Casing & Battery Management
roadmap.description: Assemble flexible silicone strap, magnetic charging dock, and verify 36-hour autonomy.
tasks: Integrate 300mAh LiPo and MCP73831 charging circuit with pogo pins
Fit assembly into SLA resin circular case with curved lens
Measure active vs deep sleep power consumption
completionCriteria: Continuous 36-hour runtime achieved on single charge cycle

assumptions.description: User maintains snug wrist contact so optical window touches skin without ambient light leakage.
assumptions.reason: PPG sensor accuracy degrades significantly under ambient light interference.

openQuestions.question: Should magnetic pogo pins or standard USB-C port be used for device charging?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Affects waterproof seal rating and enclosure thickness.

risks.title: Sensor Drift During Initial Heating
risks.mitigation: Include software lockout requiring 24 hours of burn-in heating before saving baseline calibration.

risks.title: Sensor Poisoning from Aerosols
risks.mitigation: Clearly label enclosure warnings against using silicone adhesives, hairspray, or VOC cleaners near unit.

recommendations.title: LiPo Battery Backup with Charger IC
recommendations.description: Consider adding a single-cell LiPo battery and TP4056 charging IC for 2-hour backup during power outages.
